mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong real GDP growth (GDPC1 > 13000 billion) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 230) indicates a 'Goldilocks' economy that supports corporate earnings without monetary tightening, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 13000 and CPIAUCSL < 230.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 0.5% amplifies discount rate pressures and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days despite the current low rate environment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and in a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month industrial production increase exceeding 0.5% signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month housing starts increase exceeding 5% indicates strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, boosting retail and construction sectors and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises > 5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month nonfarm payrolls increase exceeding 150,000 jobs signals labor market strength and rising consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 150000 in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% sustains low discount rates for extended periods, enabling equity valuations to rise through the 60-day horizon as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.
